groqResponse: {"answer":"ShelfSense uses Tweedie loss because 68% of the demand data is zero‑inflated; RMSE treats all errors equally and penalises zero predictions on intermittent series, whereas Tweedie loss is designed for zero‑inflated count data and actually rewards correct zero forecasts, yielding a measurable +0.02 WRMSSE improvement.","citations":[{"sourceRef":"shelfsense:tweedie"}],"followUps":[{"question":"What performance gain did Tweedie loss achieve?","sourceRef":"shelfsense:tweedie"},{"question":"How many models use Tweedie loss in ShelfSense?","sourceRef":"shelfsense:approach:3"},{"question":"What percentage of the data is zero?","sourceRef":"shelfsense:tweedie"}]}
